dct_description_sm: "To his excellency Major General Sir Thomas Shirley Bar. Captain General & Governor in Chief in and over all His Majestys Leeward Caribbee Islands, in America, Chancellor, Vice Adminal & Ordinary of the same. This map is dedicated by his obliged, humble servant, John Luffman."
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Contributors: Faden, William, 1749-1836, cartographer, publisher; Luffman, J. (John), 1756-1846, engraver
Includes text, table of acres in each parish, list of subscribers, four compass roses, and indexed inset of the town of Saint John.
LC copy assembled, sectioned in 20 and mounted on 1 piece of cloth.
